title: Adding Lucene-style ?q= query string search for alerts made the Postgres backend build WHERE clauses by str.format()-ing user search terms into SQL.

Examples: `f'"{self.tokens.field[0]}" ILIKE %({p})s'`, `f'"{self.tokens.field[0]}" ~* %({p})s'`, etc. While parameter placeholders are used for values, the column/field names are not parameterized and come directly from parsed user input.

            elif self.tokens.fieldname in ['correlate', 'service', 'tags']:
                p = _next_param(params)
                params[p] = self.tokens.singleterm
                return f'%({p})s=ANY("{self.tokens.field[0]}")'
            elif self.tokens.attr:
                tokens_attr = self.tokens.attr.replace('_', 'attributes')
                p_key = _next_param(params)
                params[p_key] = self.tokens.fieldname
                p_val = _next_param(params)
                params[p_val] = f'%{self.tokens.singleterm}%'
                return f'"{tokens_attr}"::jsonb ->>%({p_key})s ILIKE %({p_val})s'

findings.suggested_fix: Implement strict allowlisting for field names. Only allow known, safe field names from a predefined whitelist. Do not interpolate field names directly into SQL. For example: Define a ALLOWED_FIELDS set and validate `self.tokens.fieldname` and `self.tokens.field[0]` against it before using in SQL strings.

Examples: `f'"{self.tokens.field[0]}" ILIKE %({p})s'`, `f'"{self.tokens.field[0]}" ~* %({p})s'`, etc. While parameter placeholders are used for values, the column/field names are not parameterized and come directly from parsed user input.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a whitelist for allowed field/column names. Create a mapping of safe field names and only use values from this mapping in SQL queries. Reject any field names not in the whitelist.

findings.explanation: The changes in utils.py show integration of the query parser output into query building. The code receives `parsed_query` and `parsed_vars` from the parser and uses them. Authorization checks would typically be in the QueryBuilder base class or calling code (not shown in diff). The changes here are mechanical parameter passing and do not introduce new authorization bypass vulnerabilities in this section.
